opportunities.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
opportunities.description: Reduce unused JavaScript and defer loading scripts until they are required to decrease bytes consumed by network activity. [Learn how to reduce unused JavaScript](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unused-javascript/).

opportunities.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
opportunities.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. [Learn how to provide sufficient color contrast](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/color-contrast).

opportunities.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes
opportunities.description: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

opportunities.title: Elements with visible text labels do not have matching accessible names.
opportunities.description: Visible text labels that do not match the accessible name can result in a confusing experience for screen reader users. [Learn more about accessible names](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/label-content-name-mismatch).

opportunities.title: Form elements do not have associated labels
opportunities.description: Labels ensure that form controls are announced properly by assistive technologies, like screen readers. [Learn more about form element labels](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/label).

opportunities.title: Touch targets do not have sufficient size or spacing.
opportunities.description: Touch targets with sufficient size and spacing help users who may have difficulty targeting small controls to activate the targets. [Learn more about touch targets](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/target-size).

opportunities.title: Displays images with incorrect aspect ratio
opportunities.description: Image display dimensions should match natural aspect ratio. [Learn more about image aspect ratio](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/best-practices/image-aspect-ratio/).

opportunities.title: Document doesn't have a valid `hreflang`
opportunities.description: hreflang links tell search engines what version of a page they should list in search results for a given language or region. [Learn more about `hreflang`](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/hreflang/).
